Sandoz Aims to More Than Double Sales by 2035
By Adria Calatayud
Sandoz Group said it aims to more than double its net sales and boost profitability over the coming decade.

The Swiss maker of generic drugs on Tuesday set out ambitions to more than double net sales by 2035 compared with 2025 and achieve a core earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization margin above 30% by 2035.
For 2025, the company reported net sales of $11.1 billion and a core Ebitda margin of 21.7%.
Sandoz also reaffirmed previous targets through 2028.
It said it is targeting average annual sales growth in the mid-to-high single-digit percentage range at constant currency for the 2025 to 2030 period, with a core Ebitda margin of 25% to 27% by 2030.
The company separately said it is investing around $300 million in a new drug substance facility in Slovenia to expand its biosimilar manufacturing capacity.
